title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Reinstatement Fee Tariff Note
content:
**Tariff.** The reinstatement fee of a Paystride Payroll Card Program is the reinstatement fee of the package held, rounded half up to the cent.

**Order of the figures.** How the reinstatement fee is figured is settled first, and the multipliers of the reinstatement fee are applied to its result after that, before the rounding.

### Figures by package (illustration)

| Package held | Reinstatement fee |
|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 100.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 50.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 0.00 |

The figure is that of the package held when the fee is figured: a hypothetical program held in the Essential package is charged the Essential figure of 100.00.
